title: Short-rate futures: a quotation is not a cash price
objectives: Convert a discount yield into bill price and investment yield without mixing units
Separate the futures delivery date from the underlying bill's maturity
Derive quote sensitivity and the sign of a short-rate futures hedge
Distinguish a forward-style terminal sketch from daily settled futures cash flows
prerequisites: Discount factors and forward replication from chapters 02 and 08; yield sensitivity from chapter 09; futures settlement from chapter 03.
source_scope: Full English caption text for playlist positions 24 and 25 read sequentially. Historical product details are identified as source context; synthetic examples independently reconstruct the mechanics. No comprehensive audiovisual audit.
